description:
Sweep handle_* docstrings in jmap-mail-server (CANONICAL — runs first per workspace AGENTS.md propagation rule).

Pattern extracted from jmap-tasks-server (parent JMAP-h47t.30):

1. Per-handler rustdoc on every `handle_*` fn:
   - One-line title with type-specific spec ref:
       `/// Handle an `Email/get` method call (RFC 8621 §4.2).`
   - `args` shape + return-`Value` shape paragraph:
       `/// `args` is the RFC 8620 §5.1 `/get` request shape (`accountId`,
        optional `ids`, optional `properties`); the returned `Value` is the
        §5.1 `/get` response shape (`accountId`, `state`, `list`, `notFound`).`
   - Optional type-specific notes (preserve any existing notes).
   - Trailer: `/// Returns `(response_args, extra_invocations)`. The extra list is always empty.`
     (Or describes exceptions for `/copy`, `/import`, `/parse` etc.)

2. Module-level `# Wire-shape contract` paragraph on every src/*.rs file with handlers.

Files to touch (8 files, 32 handlers total):
- src/email.rs (8 handlers: get, changes, query, query_changes, set, import, parse, copy)
- src/identity.rs (3)
- src/mailbox.rs (5)
- src/mdn.rs (2)
- src/sieve.rs (4)
- src/snippet.rs (1)
- src/submission.rs (5)
- src/thread.rs (2)
- src/vacation.rs (2)

Per parent bead body: "The mail-server _changes handlers (handle_email_changes,
handle_mailbox_changes, etc.) are MISSING the 'Returns ...' trailer that the
other handlers have — this is pre-existing canonical drift that the sweep
should fix."

No API break. Pure docs. Verify with `cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-mail-server`.
title: jmap-mail-server: propagate handle_* wire-shape docstrings (canonical, runs first)
